ios.desc:
Xmind is a full-featured mind mapping and brainstorming tool, now supercharged with AI. One map takes you from inspiration to execution—turn ideas into action faster than ever, across all platforms.

Whether you're brainstorming ideas, structuring thoughts, or managing projects, Xmind gives you a seamless experience for clarity, creativity, and collaboration.

XMIND AI
• Create with AI: Generate a full mind map from any text, link, or document in seconds.
• Photo to Map: Snap a photo of your notes or a whiteboard, and AI turns it into a structured mind map.
• Draw to Map: Sketch your ideas by hand, and AI converts them into a clean mind map.
• Grow Ideas: Select any topic and let AI expand it into a full branch of related ideas.
• AI Task Breakdown: Turn any goal into actionable tasks and to-dos automatically.

VISUALIZE INFORMATION WITH MIND MAP BEING SIMPLE & EASY
• Templates: Kick-start any mind map with 30 well-designed templates.
• Skeleton & Smart Color Theme: Create one-of-a-kind maps with countless combinations of preset structures and color themes.
• Structure: Choose from 9 structures - Mind Map, Logic Chart, Brace Map, Org Chart, Tree Chart, Timeline, Fishbone, Tree Table and Matrix. Mix multiple structures in one map to handle complex projects with ease.
• Insert: Enrich a topic with image, audio note, equation, label, hyperlink, topic link, drawing, and more.
• Equation/LaTeX: Jot down mathematics and chemical equations with LaTeX.
• Audio Note: Capture information fast and never miss a word.

FOCUS ON CONTENT, AND STAY ORGANIZED & PRODUCTIVE
• Outliner: Outline thoughts hierarchically and keep it going in mind map.
• ZEN Mode: A full-screen, distraction-free mode to help you focus. (iPad only)
• Multiple Organizers: Connect topics with Relationships, group ideas with Boundary, conclude with Summary.
• Pitch Mode: Present your map as a slideshow with auto-generated transitions and layouts in one click.
• Multitasking: Open and edit 2 files side by side, e.g. GoodNotes/Notability and Xmind at once.
• Filters: Tag topics with marker & label, highlight by tags to get inspired.

ALWAYS BEING SO STYLISH, KEEP MIND MAPPING WITH FUN
• Smart Color Theme: Build an aesthetically appealing map effortlessly.
• Hand-drawn Style: Switch your map into a hand-drawn look in one click.
• Colored Branch: Stimulate creativity with more rainbow color schemes.
• Illustrations: Visualize your map with 350+ illustrations.
• Sticker: Find your favorite from 400+ brand
